name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $CRM agreed to buy $BRZE for ~$5.7B in cash, adding a real time engagement platform that was taking Marketing Cloud customers and a usage based model for Agentforce.
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $CRM agreed to buy $BRZE for ~$5.7B in cash, adding a real time engagement platform that was taking Marketing Cloud customers and a usage based model for Agentforce.
text:
$CRM just agreed to acquire $BRZE for ~$5.7B in cash bringing in a real-time customer engagement platform that had been taking customers from Salesforce’s own Marketing Cloud.

The acquisition gives Agentforce ability to act on live customer behavior while adding Braze’s usage-based revenue model as AI agents increasingly challenge traditional per-seat software pricing.

name: tae kim
zh_summary: Qualcomm will cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction" following annual reviews, notifications begin in November. Part of building stronger performance culture after falling short of expectations. (@firstadopter via Reuters)
en_summary: Qualcomm will cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction" following annual reviews, notifications begin in November. Part of building stronger performance culture after falling short of expectations. (@firstadopter via Reuters)
text:
"Oct 20 (Reuters) - Qualcomm will cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction" following its annual employee reviews, CEO Cristiano Amon told staff in a memo on Monday reviewed by Reuters, with notifications set to begin in November.

The cuts are part of an effort to build "a stronger performance culture" and address situations where the company "has consistently fallen short of expectations," Amon said."
orig:
"Oct 20 (Reuters) - Qualcomm will cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction" following its annual employee reviews, CEO Cristiano Amon told staff in a memo on Monday reviewed by Reuters, with notifications set to begin in November.
